title: Api decisions
description: The body of GET /api/decisions: one page of decision messages, newest first, optionally narrowed to one episode. The items are the decision messages the backend also publishes on the broker; the single-decision route adds the state the backend saw, which never travels over the broker. `next_cursor` is the opaque token of the next page and is null on the last one.

items.description: The decisions of this page, newest first.

next_cursor.description: Opaque token of the next page, null on the last one.
